page.title: Database
page.subtitle: Configure the global database used by the whole bot. A restart is required after switching.

sections.backendHint: The database connection AstrBot is currently using (password masked).
sections.settingsHint: SQLite uses a local file and suits single-node setups; MySQL / MariaDB suits multi-instance or external storage.

fields.passwordKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the stored password

messages.restartRequired: The config selects MySQL but AstrBot is still running on SQLite. Restart AstrBot to apply.
